sprite.name: CUNNINGHAM
sprite.incarnation: Original game incarnation, reference-based hand-painted native combat keyframes — independently painted contemporary presentation of the same original outfit

sources.scope: Physically inspected original Portable Ops-era published model render from scanned character page; hosted archive compilation publisher/authenticity independently unconfirmed. Provides visible costume, palette and anatomy; newly detailed fabric/material painting is an authored presentation, not a different canonical costume.

limits: Exactly16 actual painted physical poses per independent direction,32 per option; action groups explicitly reuse poses and do not claim full extracted motion cycles.

Detailed contemporary presentation preserves source outfit, age and palette; unreadable small original details are qualified painted interpretations. No certified absolute1:1 or new official costume attestation.

Original base/source catalogues and PNG bytes remain unchanged; new native PNGs are independent imagegen outputs. Alpha geometry and optional Canvas vector contours only, no raster editing/resampling/mirroring.
Same UID, actionMap, phaseMap, timings and numerical character stats inherited. Match gameplay validation belongs to root integration.

AnatomicalRIGHT lower-leg prosthesis, organicLEFT boot and organic arms/head retained in both independent camera views. No handheld pistol added. Mounted hover-platform boss rig remains outside this human costume source.
Base atlas was already a painted presentation despite queue basePresentation retro era label. This is a new finer painted rendering, not a claim the prior PNG was pixel art.
Generated native pixels remain intact, not a certified pixel-perfect 1:1 copy. Canonical identity/costume checked against supplied original or official references.
Sixteen visually reviewed physical keyframes per direction, thirty-two distinct poses per identity. Action groups share keyframes explicitly; no full motion-capture cycle claim.
Thirteen required action groups plus optional groups reuse actual poses. Standing source-height scale preserves shorter crouch/KO poses; timing and interpolation are duel adaptations.
Each direction independently authored; no raster mirroring. Tiny facial, insignia and weapon detail remains approximate at combat scale.

Source crops follow observed alpha components; wider KO or weapon rectangles may cross the advertised invisible grid. Canvas clip polygons exclude nearby figures where necessary, native PNG bytes unchanged.
No engine, collision, HP, lore, readiness or gameplay mutation; actual gameplay QA remains Root integration work.

Native atlas contains the human body only, with anatomical right lower-leg prosthesis. Existing mounted hover-platform and its laser/rocket mechanics must remain in Core; empty command poses do not certify a full canonical platform encounter. V1 invented pistol poses rejected and retained.

Some shooting cells include authored muzzle flash. The actual firing cell is restricted to active attack phase; startup/recovery explicitly reuse the authored recovery or weapon-manipulation pose without flash. Snake AC!D LEFT recovery has empty hands. Flash differences between independently authored directions remain qualified.
